outcome.primary_intent: Use the USGS Earthquake Catalog search UI to query the last 24 hours in UTC for worldwide earthquakes of magnitude 4.5+, sorted by largest magnitude first, and then report the top three results (magnitude, place, UTC time). A reasonable user would be flexible on minor formatting (e.g., whether “(UTC)” is repeated on each line) but not on the time range being UTC/24h, the magnitude threshold, the sort order, or the correctness of the three reported earthquakes.
